tei:div.tei:p: (367)༄༅/ 'jigs byed me yi phreng ba las/ lhan thabs dpa' bo'i g.yul bshoms bzhugs//(368)

na mo gur be/ srid gsum lto bar mid mi gshin bu rjai// zla zhun mche ba'i rno dbal bar 'tshir na// mi 'jigs mthu ldan 'jig rten gsum na su// rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed der 'dud// padma'i man ngag me yi spu gri 'bum// thog ma'i rgyal gsung dpa' bo'i g.yul bshoms pa'i// nyams pa bdun ldan srog gi gshed ma 'di// brgyud ldan rig 'dzin mgon gyi mtshon cha yin/ de la 'dir 'jam dpal gshin rje thugs kyi yang zhun/ mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi/ rdo rje yang dbang gter gyi phyag bris/ la yag gnam skas brag gi snying po/ chos rgyal ratna gling pa'i zab gter/ 'phags pa chags dang bral ba'i phyag gzhes/ snga 'gyur bka' ma'i zur rgyan mdzes pa/ padma'i ring lugs bka' gter zung 'jug mkhas grub bye ba'i gshegs shul 'khrul med lag tu bstar ba la/ gang du bya ba'i gzhi ma dul (369) ba yin na sa yi cho ga dang bcas pas de la sgo rdzogs rtsibs bzhi dmar po/ rtsibs mchan mthing ka de nang thod pa'i nang*/ chos 'byung mthing kha bsnol mar zla gam sgo gcig nag por bris pa'i khar sgrub dus bum pa bcud ldan/ gtor zlog dus zlog gtor gdong zhal 'khor lnga pa drag rgyan sku tsaka dar gdugs can dang*/ bdag bskyed mchod gtor/ las gshin dmar gtor/ sman raka zhi drag nyer spyod sogs dgos pa'i yo byad nyer bsdogs bya/ cho ga dngos la 'jug pa la/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro bas/ kun bzang 'jam dpal 'jam dpal gshin rje dang*// padma 'byung gnas rdo rje yang dbang gter// ratna gling pa mi 'gyur rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung zil gnon shog /karma chags med kun bzang shes rab (370)sogs// 'jam dpal khros pa'i rim gnyis gdengs thob cing*// nus mthu'i dpal brnyes rig 'dzin brgyud pa la// gsol ba= 'jam dpal khros pa dus dgra'i dbang po che// yum chen gshed bzhi zil gnon rtsa ba'i lha// 'chi bdag las gshin rgyud gsum dregs tshogs la// gsol ba=

gnas pa'i 'khor lo'i gnas lugs rjen par rtogs// ma rig srid pa'i 'khor lo 'phyan pa rnams// 'du byed srid pa'i 'khor lo la sbyor bas// zil gnon gcod pa'i 'khor lo mngon gyur shog rol mo byin rlabs 'bring bsdus gang rung*/ zhes dang*/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'jam dpal dus dgra'i dbang po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa ma dzaḥ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu (371)rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la= mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la= nam mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' gang ba yi// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*// sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// bdag dang 'gro kun gus pas skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces lan gsum/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams// ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la// yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/(372)sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig

nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ skyabs yul rnams rang la thim par gyur/ zhes bgegs kyi gtor ma/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin brlabs la/ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri bā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri bā ra oṃ a ka ro sogs lan gsum dang*/ sa bdag lha klu 'khor dang bcas// gtor ma dam pa 'di bzhes la// bdag gi sgrub pa ma thon bar/ khyed la gnas 'di bdag g.yar gyi// ci bde bar ni gzhan du song*/ bhu mi pa ti gatstsha sa gshegs/ bgegs gtor/ oṃ sarba bighnān na maḥsarba ta tha ga te bhyo sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ hūm̐/ bka' gsang rmad byung dkyil 'khor 'dir// 'jam dpal zhi khro'i bzhugs gnas yin// mi dang mi min (373)bar gcod bgegs// da lta nyid du gnas su dengs// ci ste mi 'gro bar bcod na// 'jam dpal khros pa'i rgyal po yi/ sprul pa yang sprul khro tshogs kyis// lus sems rdul du brlag par bya// gdug sems ldan pa da lta thul// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams brlag par gyis/ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa kro dha dzwa la ma dha la ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces bskrad/ srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams me yi rba klong 'khrugs// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal te// phrag dog nyon mongs lnga ni bsreg byed pa// ye shes lnga yi me ni phyogs bcur 'phro// phyogs mtshams me yi 'khor los gtams pa la// me yi mtshams las bgegs rnams ma 'da' zhig raṃ dzwa la raṃ phaṭaḥtrag raṃ kha raṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ brda sgo dbye ba ni/ hūm̐/ snang srid thams cad gzhal yas khang*// gzugs snang thams cad ye shes lha// ma rtogs ma rig sgo bcad pas// rang gsal ye shes sgo phye shig bhrum̐ pra be sha ya phaṭaḥ(374) brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ rang byung ye shes sems kyi lha// ma rtogs rang ngo ma shes pas// ye nas 'grogs kyang zhal ma mthong*// rang gsal brda yis phyag 'tshal lo/

a ti pū ho/ bshags pa ni/ hūm̐/ thog ma med pa'i dus nyid nas// rang dang gnyis su med mod kyang*// ma rig dbang gis ngo ma shes// rang byung ye shes lha la bshags/ sa ma ya shuddhe āḥ dam bca' ni/ hūm̐/ bskal pa sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i lha// da lta rtse gcig 'du 'bral med// srog gi phyir yang mi spong na// bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐/ byin 'bebs ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings ye shes lnga yi pho brang nas// chos sku skye med dbyangs las ma g.yos kyang*// longs sku 'jam dpal zhi khro yab yum dang*// sprul sku 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams// thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab du gsol// ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol// gsang ba'i (375)dkyil 'khor 'di la byin cig phobs// rnal 'byor lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs// gsang ba'i dam rdzas gnyen po mchod par 'bul/ khyed kyi thugs rje mchog gis bzung du gsol/ badzra a be sha ya a aḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ hūm̐/ gdod nas rang dang gnyis med lha// 'du 'bral med pa'i lha tshogs la// ma rig spyan 'byed mar me dang*// 'bru bcud bdud rtsi sbyar ba'i skyems// zhal zas rmad byung gtor ma dang*// chags med rakta'i arghaṃ dang*// dam rdzas bdud rtsi sman gyi mchog /thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul lags na// gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du bzhes/ zhes dang*/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod snod bhandza 'bar bar mchod rdzas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dbyings dang ye shes kyi rnam rol/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams su lhun gyi grub pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/(376)oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas

shabta'i bar dang*/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ yaṃ kaṃ las rlung me thod sgyed kyi steng du āḥlas thod pa'i snod du oṃ hūm̐ swa aṃ hā muṃ lāṃ maṃ pāṃ tāṃ las lcags kyu lnga dang sgron ma lnga so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams khol/ steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gnas pa las 'od 'phros/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkugs thim zhu ba las dam tshig gi rdzas dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba patstsha a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ lan gsum/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i ye shes kyi ka pā la stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib 'dod yon lnga'i phung po zad mi shes par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba lingta te dzwa ba liṃ ta ba la ba ti gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ lan gsum/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i padma 'bar ba'i snod du raḥlas chags med rakta'i rgya mtsho rba klong (377)mkha' la 'phyo zhing 'khrugs pa zegs ma las 'dod yon gyi lha mo 'phro bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ lan gsum/ de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ni/ chos thams skye ba med pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ hūm̐/ ma bcos pa ni chos kyi sku// mtshan ma gzung 'dzin dri ma bral// rtog pa med pa nam mkha'i ngang*// de bzhin nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ oṃ ma hā shun+ye ta dzñā na badzra swa bha wa atma ko3 haṃ/ kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ hūm̐/ ma bcos pa ni chos kyi sku// mtshan ma gzung 'dzin dri ma bral// rtog pa med pa nam mkha'i ngang*// de bzhin nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bha wa atma ko3 haṃ/ kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/

hūm̐/ ma rig 'khrul pa 'khor lo'i klong*// gzung 'dzin bag chags rab brtas nas// ma rtogs zo chun lta bur 'khor// kun tu snang du bsgom par bya'o/ oṃ dharma dhartu swa bhā ba shuddho3 haṃḥ rgyu yi ting nge 'dzin ni/ snod bcud thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngang las/ bdag nyid bhrūm̐ ser nag gcig tu gyur/ hūm̐/ chos rnams rten cing 'brel ba ste// rgyu las ma byung gang yang med// sa bon las (378)ni 'bras bu bzhin// rgyu yi yi ge bsgom par bya'o/ oṃ badzra tsitta badzra sa ma ti hūm̐/ bhrūm̐ e yaṃ baṃ laṃ raṃ/ oṃ las nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor byung*// rgya khyon dpag med kha dog dkar// gti mug dag pa'i rang bzhin te// kun tu bzang mo'i mkha' yi dbyings// yaṃ las rlung gi da la byung*// ba dan mtshan pa sngo skya la// phrag dog dag pa'i rang bzhin te/ yum chen sgrol ma'i mkha' yi dbyings// baṃ las chu yid la byung*// dbyibs zlum kha dog sngon po la// 'dod chags dag pa'i rang bzhin te// ma ma ki yi mkha' yi klong*// laṃ las gser gyi sa gzhi byung*// gru bzhi pa la kha dog ser// nga rgyal dag pa'i rang bzhin te// sangs rgyas spyan ma'i mkha' yi klong*// raṃ las me yi da la byung*// gru gsum pa la kha dog dmar// zhe sdang dag pa'i rang bzhin te/ gos dkar mo yi mkha' yi klong*/ suṃ las gser gyi ri rab la// gru bzhi pa la kha dog bzhi// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor (379)bzhugs gnas so/ bhrūm̐ dzñā na kro dha/ bhrūm̐ las gnam lcags las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang sogs nas gzhung ltar bgyi/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya gnas gsum la btugs bzhin/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya badzra swa bhā ba atma ko3 haṃ/ de'i 'gres kyis/ wāka dang tsitta sbyar/ rang gi spyi bo'i gnas lngar de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbu brgyan te ye shes lnga yi dbang bskur bar gyur/

oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥ rig lnga'i dbang rgya mgo bo'i gnas lngar btugs cing*/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bha ba atma ko3haṃ/ de bzhin du/ a darsha/ sa manta/ pra ti bekṣa na/ krishna nuṣṭha na/ so sor sbyar/ yab kyi thugs kar raṃ las sogs bzhung ltar bgyi / ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs bar gyur/ hūm̐/ 'og min lhun gyi grub pa yi// lho phyogs e yi dkyil 'khor nas// 'jigs byed chen po 'bar ba'i sku// ya manta ka gshegs su gsol// chos sku skye med ngang nyid las// thabs (380)kyi sprul pa'i khro rgyal ni// gshin rje gshed po bgegs kyi rgyal// dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol// sangs rgyas kun gyi sku che ba// rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed// gsang chen dam pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ hūm̐/ lho phyogs gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor nas// bsad khram 'bar ba e yi klong*// rtsub 'gyur tshal gyi dur khrod nas/ 'jigs byed 'bar ba gshegs su gsol// 'gro ba'i rnam rtog bzlog pa dang*// dbang bskur byin gyis brlab pa dang*// thugs rje yis ni dgongs mdzod la// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das/ ya manta ka e hya hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐/ rtogs par gyur pa'i dus nyid na// dam tshig ye shes gnyis med de// chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin du// du ma ro gcig ngo mtshar che'o/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ spyi bor thim pas rang dang gnyis su med par gyur/ phyag 'tshal ni/ hūm̐/ chos rnams rang bzhin ye nas dag rtog 'khrul 'jig rten (381)sems can la// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi// byams pa'i char chen cir yang 'bebs// thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ a ti pū ho/ pra titstsha ho/ phyag rgya gar mchod ni/ hūm̐/ gdul bya mos pa tha dad pas// zhi dang khro dang 'dres pa'i tshul// sku mdog zhal phyag bsam las 'das/

gar dbyangs phyag rgya'i mchod pa 'bul/ ma hā mu dra pū dza ho/ nyer spyod mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dgongs spyod la// mchod dang ma mchod gnyis med kyang*// zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun/ bdag gi gus pas 'bul lags na// 'gro ba'i don du thugs rjes bzhes/ oṃ ya manta ka pa pā ri bā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swa hā/ de bzhin du 'gres sbyar te/ zhab bsil/ patyaṃ/ me tog puṣpe/ bdug spos/ dhu pe/ mar me/ ā lo ke dri chab/ gandhe/ zhal zas/ ne bi tya/ rol mo/ shabta/ de bzhin du rgyal srid la/ tshig rkang gsum pa dang sngags la/ dzambu'i (382)gser gyi 'khor lo 'di/ tsakra ratna/ yid ṣa ratna/ mtshams 'di nas ma dper nor bu btsun mo blon po bcas 'bul pa'i tshig rkang 'ga' zhig chad dam snyam/ (?) stobs ldan glang po rin chen 'di/ hasti ratna/ rdzu 'phrul rta mchog rin chen 'di/ tu raṅga a shwa ratna mthar byed dmag dpon rin chen 'di/ khatka ratna/ de bzhin 'dod yon lnga la/ rdo rje gzugs kyi mchod sprin 'di/ rū pa pañtsa ka ma gu ṇa/ rdo rje sgra yi mchod sprin 'di/ shabda pañtsa ka ma gu ṇa/ rdo rje dri yi mchod sprin 'di/ ghandhe pañtsa ka ma gu na/ rdo rje ro yi mchod sprin 'di/ ghandhe pañtsa ka ma gu na/ rdo rje ro yi mchod sprin 'di/ ra sa pañtsa ka ma gu na/ rdo rje reg bya'i mchod sprin 'di/ sparshe pañtsa ka ma gu ṇa/ rdo chos kyi mchod sprin 'di/ dnarma pañtsa ka ma gu ṇa/

de bzhin du sgeg sogs brgyad la/ rdo rje sgeg mo ma yi tshogs/ oṃ badzra la sye hūm̐/ rdo rje phreng ba ma yi tshogs/ oṃ badzra mā lye hūm̐/ rdo rje glu dbyangs ma yi tshogs/ oṃ badzra girti hriḥ rdo rje gar mkhan ma yi tshogs/ oṃ badzra nīrti āḥ rdo rje bdug spos ma yi tshogs/ oṃ badzra dhu pe (383)hūm̐/ rdo rje me tog ma yi tshogs/ oṃ badzra puṣpe traṃ/ rdo rje mar me ma yi tshogs/ oṃ badzra a lo ke hrīḥ rdo rje dri chab ma yi tshogs/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥ de bzhin du drag po'i mchod pa la/ dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog 'di/ oṃ shma shan pū dzi sa pā ri bā ra puṣpaṃ pra titstsha swa hā/ gsur chen dri yi bdug spos 'di/ sngags drag mchod ltar la/ dhu paṃ/ zhun chen snang gsal mar me 'di/ di paṃ/ rdo rje dri chu'i byug pa 'di/ gandhaṃ/ bdud rtsi dri chen zhal zas 'di/ nai bi tyaṃ/ rkang gling thod rnga'i rol mo 'di/ shabta/ sman mchod ni/ hūm̐/ rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman// rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos// ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas// rgyu drug sems can kun sgrol phyir// dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi che/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ hūm̐/ rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i// thun mong mchog dang khyad par 'di// dus gsum bla ma (384)yi dam lha// rgyal ba zhi khro thams cad la// rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje brtse dgongs dbang dang dngos grub rtsol/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ kun bzang 'jam dpal= sogs brgyud 'debs shwa lo ka gsum gyi rkang pa gsum pa'i rjes/ rnam dag= thugs rje= sarba= sbyar/ dngos grub blangs ba ni/ hūm̐/ lce yi dam tshig rdo rje la// rdo rje can gyi oṃ bsgom te// mtheb dang srin lag rtse sbyar nas// thabs dang shes rab phyag rgya yis// myong ba dngos grub mchog thob 'gyur/

ka ya siddhi oṃ/ wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma las// 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro// mchod sbyin dam rdzas chen po 'di// thugs dam bskang phyir bzhes su gsol/ ma hā ba lingta khā hi/ rakta'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i chags pa'i bcud// rakta dmar gyi arghaṃ sbrengs// 'dod chags rgya mtsho skem pa'i phyir// mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ ma hā rakta khā hi/ sbyor (385) ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dbyings ye gnyis med sbyor ba yis// 'khor 'das gnyis su med par sbyor// gnyis med rtogs pa'i sbyor mchod 'di// 'gro ba'i don du thugs rjes bzhes/ ma hā ga ṇa pū dza ho/ sgrol mchod ni/ hūm̐/ yang dag don rtogs blo yis ni// ma rtogs sems can gnas su sgral// dus gsum bde gshegs de la mnyes// mchog gi mchod pa chen po 'di// 'gro ba'i don du thugs rjes bzhes/ ma hā tā na pū dza ho/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ gdod nas rang rig lha ru dag /mchod bya mchod byed mchod yuul kun// mi dmigs spros bral phyag rgya che// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i tshogs la 'bul/ ma hā dharma dhartu pū dza ho/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ mnyam nyid sku yi rang bzhin ni// kun bzang zag par med par bde// sems can don la bde bar gshegs// thugs rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ rtsol med rang byung chos sku'i sgra// ma 'gags pa la 'jigs pa (386)med// chags bral skyon med rdo rje'i gsung*// yang dag gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ spros pa med pa dbyings kyi ngang*// ma skyes 'jigs med rdo rje'i thugs// blang dor med pa chos kyi dbyings// 'gyur med thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings bde ba chen po la// rtsal dang rtsol bar mi dmigs kyang*// nam mkha' mdzod kyis cho 'phrul gyis// yon tan re bskong phyag 'tshal bstod/

hūm̐/ rang bzhin cir yang ma nges kyang*// dkyil 'khor chen po'i cha bzung nas// rtog med dregs pa ngang gi 'dul// phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ de nas dzab bzla ba ni/ hūm̐/ ya manta ka'i thugs ka ru// bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed// smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// g.yas pa be con g.yon pa thod khrag bsnams// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum yum dang sbyor// rgyan dang cha lugs gtso dang mthun// thugs dkar gser gyi 'khor lo la// gsang ba'i 'khor lo sems la gnas// sems la sems lus chos kyi sku/(387)/srid pa'i 'khor lo lte bar gnas/ khams gsum srid gsum de na gnas// sprul pa'i 'khor lo zhabs 'og na// 'gro drug skye sgo de na gnas// gcod pa'i 'khor lo phyag mtshan na// phrin las rnam bzhis thogs med gcod// sku la 'khor lo rnam bzhi rdzogs/ thugs ka gnas pa'i 'khor lo tsitta rin chen zur brgyad las 'od 'phros/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la phog pas gnyis med du gyur/ srid pa'i 'khor lo lte ba nas 'od 'phros/ khams gsum srid pa gsum du spros/ 'khor ba gnas stongs/ sprul pa'i 'khor lo zhabs 'og nas 'phros/ 'gro ba rigs drug sems can la phog pas skye ba med par gyur/ gcod pa'i 'khor lo phyag mtshan be con 'khor lo nas 'od 'phros/ phrin las rnam bzhi dus gcig la mdzad/ lha ma srin sde brgyad la phog pas/ srog bcud la phab te/ thams cad byang chub sems kyi ngang du ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ a kro te ka ya mānta ka ha na ma tha bhandza hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes ci nus (388) pa dang*/ bsnyen tshad la 'bum phrag gcig go bdag lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sku gsung thugs byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas rang la thim par gyur/ oṃ kā la ru pa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ

zhes pa 'bum tsho gsum/ yab kyi thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor ba las sngags phreng 'phros/ sogs gong ltar dang*/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭi wi kri ta na na na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes pa 'bum phrag bdun no/ tshe yi bsnyen pa ni/ a kra 'i shams du/ a yu dzñā na g.yu tshe a ba na ya bhrūṃ/ tshe bhrūm̐ g.yu bhrūm̐ a yu dzñā na bhrūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ tshe 'gugs ni/ hūm̐/ tshe la dbang mdzad gshin rje'i gshed/ phyag mtshan be con 'khor lo yi/ gshin rje'i gnas khang bcom nas ni/ gshin rje'i lag nas tshe 'phrog la/ rnal 'byor bdag la tshe stsol cig ces bskul bas/ rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi tshe nyams pa dang brkus pa thams cad slar (389)thob par bsam/ srung ba'i dmigs bzlas ni/ rang nyid dpal chen ya manta kar gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang sogs gzhung ltar bgyi/ sngags gnyis la srung shams sbrel ba stong phrag tsam dang*/ slar rang 'jigs byed du gsal bas bzlas kyang chog mod phyag rgya zil gnon du gnas bsgyur na/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa/ sems can kun la khyab pa'i snying rje tshad med pa bsgom/ rig pa'i ngo bo sems nyid yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag hūm̐ de las e 'phros pas gnam lcags kyi gur khang*/ de'i phyir badzra las rdo rje'i gur/ de'i phyir tsakra tikṣ+ṇa karma kī la ya las 'khor lo dbyug to ral gri phur bu'i gur/ de'i phyir raṃ las me dpung gi gur/ de dag kyang rgya che ba/ 'phang mtho ba/ cis kyang mi shigs pa/ ya ma ti ra baṃ/ gshin rje ya manta ka hūm̐/ bdag nyid dpal gshin rje gshed phyag rgya zil gnon sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad pa/ zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing nag phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po na 'khor lo (390)rtsibs brgyad pa rno ba'i ngar dang ldan pa/ bar pa ral gri/ tha ma ral gri/ g.yon dang po lcags kyu/

bar pa btun shing*/ tha ma sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rdo rje'i gshog pa g.yas na gdengs pa/ rin po che'i gshog pa g.yon na gdengs pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan pa/ thod pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcus se ral kha byas pa/ zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi/ glangachen gyi ko rlon/ stags lpags kyi sham thabs sbrul nag khras ske rags byas pa/ de'i g.yon na yum gtum mo khrag mig ma mthing nag g.yas gri gug yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum yab la 'khyud pa/ bdag gi spyi gtsug tu bya khyung nag po/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad khyung dang rdo rjes gtams pa/ me'i gshog pa rdeb pa/ krang krang kring kring zhes sgra tong tong sgrogs pa'o/ pu ri dkar po e las lcags kyi gur khang*/ laṃ las rdo rje'i gur khang*/ raṃ las me'i gur khang*/ de'i nang du bdag (391)dang srung bya thams cad tshud par gyur/ oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakra srungs/ he ka ya ma du ru tsakra srungs/ ghṛ ma ya ma du ru tsakra srungs/ sarba tsitta gzer thuṃ bighnān trig nan rbad nan zlog ya/ saṃ ghṛ be ri bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ca ེsa bzla/ de dag gi mtshams so sos stong tshig gi mchod pa/ hūm̐/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod/ bag med 'gal 'khrul nyams chags bshags/ ma hā pañtsa a mri ta rakta ba liṃ ta khā hi/ de nas mdun bskyed ni/ shu n+ya ta= bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sogs pas gzhung ltar gyi lha bskyed/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol/ phyag mchod/ bstod pa/ bsnyen bsgrub las gsum gyi sngags ci nus/ dbang dang dngos grub blang ba/ bzlog dmigs bzlog sngags ring ba nyer gcig tsam grub nas/ pu ri nag po de nyid e las lcags kyi khang sgrom 'bar bar liṅga byad ma dngos su gyur pa'i kho'i yi dam chos skyong srung ma (392)rnams 'khor lo la thims pas kho rang gi lha srung kho rang gi gshed du babs nas sgrol bar gyur/

oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakra zlog he ka ya ma du ru tsakra zlog ghṛ ma ya ma du ru tsakra zlog sarba tsitta gzer thuṃ big nan trig nan rbad ya zlog ya/ saṃ ghṛ be ri/ byad ma'i sha rgyud snying la ma ra ya/ dbugs rgyud srog la mā ra ya/ khrag rgyud rtsa la mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥzlog ya/ zhes ci nus bzla/ bdag nyid gshin rje tshe bdag mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs pa dgra bo gsod pa la rngams pa/ phyag g.yas pas dgra bo'i ske gcod pa/ phyag g.yon pas dgra bo'i snying 'dren pa/ phreng ba phyir bsgyur bas dgra bo'i mgo rbad rbad gcod par gyur pa/ mdun gyi las kyi pho nya gza' bdud nag po 'jigs su rung ba phyag gnyis mda' gzhu dang*/ chu srin zhags pa 'dzin pa/ dbu dgu rtsa ba'i zhal gdangs pa'i nang du 393)ske yi srog rtsa nas khrag babs pa song bar gyur/ e sa bhyo zlog zhes stong tsam bzla/ mthar khyab 'jug zhal dgra phyogs su bstan par bsam/ lag g.yas zla ba/ g.yon nyi ma/ de gnyis brdab pa'i bar du dgra bo thams cad sgo nga bcar ba ltar song bar gyur/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka'= bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyi bka'= yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi= dpal tshe bdag nag po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi= sngags 'chang bdag gi bka' bden pa chen pos rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la chags che ba dang*/ nyams nga ba/ rmi lam ngan pa/ ltas ngan pa/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs rbod gtong rbad 'dre byad kha/ zor kha/ phur kha/ gtad kha/ khyad par du bzlog pa byed pa'i mthu dang nus pa thams cad kho rang gi steng du zlog cig rang gshed rang la phob cig rang srog rang gis chod (394)cig rang sha rang gis zo zhig rang khrag rang gis 'thung zhig kho rang gi lha srung thams cad kho rang gi gshed du phob/

bdag gi chos skyong thams cad kho'i gshed du phob/ mā ra ya zlog bhyo/ zhes thal mo lan gsum brdab bo/ de nas las byang gshin rje'i phrin las ni/ swa bha ba= stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid dpal chen po rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs nas brten bskyed/ drang bstim/ dbang bskur/ dam bzhag mchod cing bstod pa'i/ drag shul can la phyag 'tshal bstod/ zhes pa'i rjes su 'og gi bzlas dmigs/ mdun du chos rgyal gyi thugs kar sogs dang*/ ka la rū pa stong tsam bzla'o/ de nas phrin las kyi rgyab dpung bcol ba'i gtor ma 'bul ba la/ rtsa gsum spyi gtor ni/ oṃ badzra a mri ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ swa bhā ba=stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang phun sum tshogs par a las bhañtsa 'bar ba'i snod bzang zhing rgya che ba rnams su hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo la sogs (395)pa mchod pa'i dngos po rnams 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bus nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ a hūm̐ nas shabta'i bar dang*/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la brten pa'i a yig las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod du bcud thams cad hūm̐ oṃ swa aṃḥha mūṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ las bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lngar gyur pa so so'i sa bon gyi mtshan pa dang bcas pa'i 'og gi rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas thams cad zhu zhing 'dres pa'i steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge gsum gnas pa las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug yi ge gsum la thim te rim par zhu ba las dam tshig gi rdzas dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa

sogs lan gsum/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i padma sogs gong gi sngon 'gro'i (396) skabs ltar sngags lan gsum/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me sogs gang ltar sngags lan gsum/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mkha' khyab kyi 'khor lor sad par gyur/ hūm̐/ dmigs med mkha' ltar khyab cing dag pa'i sku// spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang*// thugs rje'i ngang nyid chos skur dag pa las// ye shes thugs rjer rol cing gshegs su gsol/ oṃ e hya hi bha ga wan/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dri shya ho/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ hūm̐/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes su gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru maṇḍa la dhe ba ga ṇa sa pā ri ba re bhyaḥbadzra arghaṃ pra titstsha swa hā/ de nas

shabta'i bar dang*/ badzra pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā rakta kha raṃ khā hi/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung (397)ba'i rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyi 'os zer gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ gong gi sngags mthar/ sa pa ri bā ra i dam ba liṃ ghṛhṇantu ma ma siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ zhes lan gsum/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// bcom ldan khro bo'i rgyal po ni// sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor los bsgyur// gdul dka' ma lus 'dul ba po/ khro bo'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ mthing nag mi bzad srin po'i gzugs// gar dgu'i nyams ldan rngam zhing khro// gtum chen nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi// rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// rab 'jigs ha ha hūm̐ phaṭa kyi// rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug stong ldir// rdo rje'i gad mo sa gsum g.yo/ khro rgyal gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// mi dmigs khyab brdal zab gsal ba// spros pa kun bral ye shes che// smra bsam brjod med rdo rje'i thugs/ khro rgyal thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ zhing rdul kun gyi (398)grangs snyed kyis// lus btud pa yi rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ rnal 'byor bdag cag= sogs so/ de nas dam can chen po bdun gyi phrin las ni/ shu n+ya ta sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod thod mkhar 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang chen por sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ma ning nag po sku mdog mthing nag gtum zhing khros pa'i rnam pa can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'bar ba'i ru mtshon rnon po gnam du 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon gdug pa can gyi snying dang zhags pa 'dzin pa spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/

zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ sbrul nag po'i ral pa thur du 'phyang ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ snying phreng dang sbrul gyi chun pos brgyan pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber brtsegs mar gsol zhing*/ gser sked dang mi lpags rlon pa'i ska rags can/ tsandan gyi bing chen (399)sked la btsugs pa'i sgo gsum nas sprul pa'i dmag dpung 'gyed pa/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i cod pan lhab lhub dang 'jigs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis klubs pa dang*/ g.yon brkyang gis ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ las mgon srog bdud sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi mgon po sogs bka' sdod dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ mgon po'i g.yas su dpal ye shes kyi lha mo sngags kyi srung ma smug nag ral gcig spyan gcig mche gcig nu gcig ma/ g.yas zhing dbyug 'phyar zhing g.yon dgra snying lcags spyang 'gyed pa/ mi lpags kyi gos dang 'ja' sprin gyi stod g.yog stag lpags kyi sham thabs/ thod pa dang rus pas brgyan te g.yon brkyang pa'i gar stabs gyis ro'i khar gnas pa/ 'khor sprul pa'i ma mo rnam gsum/ sbyor sgrol gsod gcod kyi ging gsum/ ye shes kyi ma mo lnga/ rje mo bcu bzhi sman mo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad sogs snang srid ma mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ mgon po'i g.yon du yum (400)dpal 'bar ma dkar mo g.yas shel gri 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag gtso la stob pa ma mo'i chas can rol pa'i stabs kyis 'gying ba la ma mo bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ shar du shan pa srog sgrub nag mo rngams shing khros pa/ g.yas gri gug rnon po 'phyar zhing g.yon nad rkyal thogs shing dgra bo'i glo snying za ba/ mi lpags kyi gos dang thod rus sbrul gyis brgyan zhing srid pa'i rlung nag la zhon pa/ g.yas na lce spyang gdong ma/ g.yon na wa gdong ma/ mdun na 'ug gdong ma/ rgyab na las byed ma sogs sha za dang ma mo 'bum sdes bskor ba/

lho ru gza' bdud rā hu la dud kha mgo bo dgu pa phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang ral gri/ 'og ma gnyis sbrul zhags dang mda' gzhus dgra snying gzir ba/ lus kun mig gis gang zhing ro smad sbrul du 'khyil ba/ dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas can/ gza' dang gdong mo rgyu skar sogs 'jigs byed dregs pa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba/ nub tu skyes mchog rdo rje legs pa dmar (401)po/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes dgra mgo gzir zhing*/ g.yon mi snying 'dzin pa/ dar dmar gyi ber dang brjid pa'i chas can/ seng ge dkar mo la chibs pa/ 'khor ging chen sde bzhi lha btsan bdud kyi dge bsnyen sum brgya drug bcu dgyes sde mo bcu gnyis za byed mche ba can sogs dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ byang du gnod sbyin shan pa dmar nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ral gri g.yon gnyis thod pa dang snying zhags 'dzin pa/ dar dmar gyi ber dang dur khrod kyi chas can mkha' lding la zhon pa/ las byed pho nya sde brgyad sogs sha za bshan pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ gzhan yang dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu/ bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis/ dge bsnyen nyi shu rtsa gcig gter rigs bco brgyad srung ma/ dkar phyogs yul lha gzhi bdag sogs srid gsum dregs pa'i tshogs bsam gyi mi khyab pas bskor ba/ thams cad kyang 'jigs shing rngam pa'i gzugs 'chang zhing (402)phrin las 'dod dgur bsgyur bas sgrub pa po'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba'i tshul gyis gnas pa'o/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ri bo/ chos dbyings yum gyi mkha'/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i gling*/ ri rab kyi rtse dur khrod chen po brgyad sogs grub pa'i gnas yul dgyes par spyod pa'i zhing khams thams cad nas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ma ning nag po/

ma mo sngags kyi srung ma/ dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug shan pa srog sgrub nag mo/ gza' yi dge bsnyen rā hu la/ gnod sbyin shan pa dmar nag dam can rdo rje legs pa sogs dam can sde bdun 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa ma dzaḥ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gi sogs sde bdun rang gzhung gi spyan 'dren dang*/ bzhugs gsol gyi 'phros su/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po sogs dam can sde bdun 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las (403)ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs sogs nas phrin las mdzod cig ces dam la gzhag hūm̐/ ye shes dang ni sogs phyag 'tshal dang*/ mchod pa'i 'phros su spro na phyi yi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ yan lag brgyad ldan yi 'ong mchod yon ldan// rab gtsang dwangs pa'i zhabs bsil rgya mtshor bskyil/ sna tshogs lta sdug chu skyes lang tsho bzhad// grub dang sbyar ba'i bdug pa sprin ltar gtibs// mun snang mthar byed sgron me'i nyin mor byed// yid 'ong byug pa lha yi chu bo'i rgyun// ro bcud phun tshogs zhal zas lhun por spungs// snyan brjid rol mo'i sgra dbyangs dang bcas pa'i/ phyi yi mchod sprin 'dod yon 'dzad med gter// 'bul gyis tshim zhing dgyes nas dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī badzra dharma pā la sa pa ri bā ra badzra arghaṃ nas shabta 'i bar dang*/ pañtsa ka ma gu ṇa pra titstsha swa hā/ nang gi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ gdug pa'i snying khrag mchod yon mtsho ltar bskyil// myos byed dug (404)khrag zhabs bsil rngam zhing brjid// dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog tshar du dngar// sha chen dud pa'i sprin phung lang long g.yo// zhun chen mar me bskal pa'i me lngar 'bar// khrag zhag bdud rtsi'i dri chab rlabs phreng g.yo// sha khrag rus pa'i zhal zas che brjid rngams// drag po'i rol mos sa gsum 'dar zhing g.yo// dur khrod nang gi mchod sprin bsam mi khyab// 'bul gyis tshims zhing dgyes nas dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī badzra dharma pā la sa pa ri bā ra ma hā sha ma sha na pū dza arghaṃ

nas shabta pra titstsha swa hā/ gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ sgrib pa'i dri ma kun spangs shing*// rtog pa kun las nges grol ba// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra dharma pā la sa pa ri bā ra ma hā a nu rā ga pra titstsha swa hā/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/(405)/bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi/ oṃ shrī badzra dharma pā la sa pā ri bā ra ma hā pañtsa a mri ta kha raṃ khā hi/ stong gsum bhandza'i snod yangs su// dam nyams bsgral ba'i maṃ sa dang*// rakta'i rgya mtsho chen por bskyil// bsad khrag rba klong 'khrugs pas mchod// oṃ shrī dharma pā la sa pa ri bā ra ma hā rakta kha raṃ khā hi/ hūm̐/ mtshan dang ldan pa'i bhandza ru// sha lnga bdud rtsi'i dam tshig lnga// bza' bca'i 'dod yon bsam mi khyab// rmad byung bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa'i// mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di// dpal ldan rdo rje nag po che// lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// dgyes par rol la phrin las mdzod// lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu hya raṃ siddhi hūm̐ phaṭaḥ sa pā ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ oṃ ro ru e ka dza ṭi snying kha rakmo ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥ sa pā ri= oṃ (406)ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa a shugme hūm̐ bhyo dzaḥ sa pa ri= oṃ khyi kha le nag mos sodaḥ srog ma sri sodaḥ snying kha kha baṃḥ ya ya sodaḥ tsa baṃ bi ri mu sodaḥ gha ya sodaḥ nṛ ya sodaḥ rakmo tsitta rbudaḥ sa pa ri= hri shag ru raṃ nā ge tsitta traṃ ma ma yo za 'gram ha he yo gi sha la dzaḥdzaḥ sa pa ri= e he rma ru tse gu ṇa hri tri ghraṃ bhyoḥ sha raṃ bhyoḥ

su ru dza ghṛgaḥ ha la 'gran ta ya dzaḥdzaḥ sa pā ri= oṃ badzra sa dhu sa ma ya bhag traṃ she ni pra ma ni sa ma ya sa dhu tri dzaḥ sa pa ri= zhes lan gsum gsum mthar/ dpal ma hā kā la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po/ gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi srung ma/ dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug shan pa srog sgrub nag mo/ gza'i dge bsnyen rā hu la/ gnod sbyin shan pa dmar nag dam can rdo rje legs pa la sogs te dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog (407)gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun dang chos kyi rgyal srid skyongs/ 'jig rten gyi rgud pa sol/ sems can gyi phan bde spel/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi sdong grogs mdzod/ sngags 'chang rnams kyi phrin las sgrubs/ sdang ba'i dgra thul/ gnod pa'i bgegs choms/ khyad par dam tshig gis 'dir 'dus pa rnams kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen smon pa'i legs tshogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig hūm̐/ dpal chen he ru ka yi sku gsung thugs las sprul sogs kyis bstod pa/ oṃ/ ye shes las grub sogs kyi bshags pa'i 'phros su spro na gter bdag dang gzhi bdag gi gtor 'bul bya/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ mgon po lcam dral 'khor bcas kyi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig la sogs pa'i mthar rang rang gi srog sngags rigs kyi kha dog can gyis bskor ba bdag skyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis phog (408)pas thugs kyi rgyud rab tu bskul bas ci 'dod pa'i phrin las rab 'byams thogs med tu sgrub par gyur/ oṃ badzra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la yaḥ badzra he ru kaḥ

twe no pa tiṣṭhaḥ dhṛ dhro me bha waḥ su toṣyo me bha baḥ su po ṣyo me bha baḥ a nu rakto me bha baḥ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstshaḥ sarba karma su tsa me tsittaṃ shrāe ya ku ru hūm̐ḥ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan sarba ta thā ga taḥ he ru ka ma me muñtsaḥ he ru ka bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces dang*/ gong gnon gyi bzlas pa a kro te ka sngon du 'gro bas bzla bya'i ma mo ma gtogs pa gong gi gtor 'bul skabs kyi sngags rnams yin la/ ma mo sngags kyi srung mar/ trag raksha kha mant+ra mu ru mu ru hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ rakmo te keng tsa tsha kha la bhyo ru lu ru lu ma ti bhyoḥ de rnams kyi mthar/ oṃ ma hā kā la yaḥ shā sa naḥ u pa ha ri ṇiḥ e ṣa a pañtsi ma kā lo a yaṃ i daṃ ratna tra yā yaḥ a pa kā ri ṇaṃḥ ya di pra ti dzñā sma ra si ta dāḥ i daṃ duṣṭhaṃ kha kha khā hi khā (409)hiḥ ma ra ma ra gṛhṇa gṛhṇaḥ bhandha bhandhaḥ ha na ha naḥ da ha da haḥ pa tsa pa tsa di na me ke na hūm̐ phaṭaḥhūm̐ḥ 'di rnams ji tsam nus pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ shrī badzra dharma pa la sa pa ri bā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swa hā nas shabta 'i bar dang*/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hiḥ hūm̐/ ye shes las grub sogs nas dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gsan cing dgongs su gsol// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgyas par mdzod// dam tshig 'gal 'khrul nyams chag mthol zhing bshags// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes rjod/ de nas tshogs byin gyi rlob pa ni/ oṃ/ sarba dra byams bi shwa dha ni hūm̐ phaṭaḥ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros pas ma dag pa'i dngos 'dzin thams cad bsregs gtor bkrus te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las tshogs gzhong padma 'bar ba tshogs rdzas rigs lnga yab yum kyi dam tshig chen po'i rang bzhin 'dod yon gyi rnam pa cir yang 'char bar (410)gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'jam dpal gshin rje 'khor dang bcas// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren na// dam tshig dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir bzhugs// dga' dad gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ e hya hi ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dri shya hoḥ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya st+wamaḥ na ma ya miḥ spyir mchod pa ni/ oṃ shrī badzra la sya hūm̐ḥ de bzhin du/ ma le traṃḥ girti hrīḥ nirti āḥ dhu pe hūm̐ḥ puṣpe traṃḥ a lo ke hrīḥ ghandhe āḥ tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim dang*// ro ldan zhal zas reg bya bde// gar dang glu dang chos yid tshim// 'dod yon lha mos nam mkha' gang*// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskang la dngos grub stsol// ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ bar bshags ni/ hūm̐/ zhal zas bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod 'di// rang byung ye shes lha rnams la// thugs dam skong phyir 'bul lags na// g.yar dam nyams pa skong phyir bzhes// badzra sa ma ya shuddhe aḥ tshogs tha ma (411) bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐/ rnal 'byor sgrub la bar chad bgegs// tshogs la bstims te bsgral bar bya// dug gsum sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs// 'khor ba dbyings su sgrol phyir bzhes// sarba shā trūṃ mā ra ya phaṭaḥ maṃ sa rakta tsitta la khā hiḥ

de ni snyen sgrub dang tshogs mchod skabs su sbyor/ gtor bzlog dus bar bshags 'phros su thugs dam skul ba ni/ hūm̐/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// gshin rje chu glang bshibs pa'i khri steng nas// gshin rje'i tshogs rnams 'dul ba'i lha tshogs ni// bcom ldan dpal chen khro rgyal gshin rje gshed// sbyor ba'i yum mchog gtum mo dug hrul ma// thugs sprul sras mchog ya ma rā dza dang*// myos byed 'bar ba aryā me ru tse// ral pa tshar dgu pho gshed mo gshed dang*// khyad par phyag rgya zil gnon rtsa ba'i lha// bka' sdod 'chi bdag las kyi gshen rje sogs// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs thugs dam can// mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dam tshig dkyil 'khor (412)'di la brtan par bzhugs// gnyis su med par phyag bgyid bzhes su gsol// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bstod do phrin las mdzod// zhes dang las gshin skul ba/ hūm̐/ 'di nas lho yi sogs nas bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// zhes pa'i bar dang dam can sde bdun skul ba/ hūm̐/ bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs sogs nas bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /zhes pa'i bar rjod/ gser skyems 'bul ba ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ gser skyems zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud bla ma dam pa dang*// bde gshegs kun 'dus zhi khro rab 'byams lha/ khyad par 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs rnams// gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung bskyed// las kyi gshin rje dam can chen po bdun// dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yab yum sras// bka' nyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas pa rnams// gser skyems= sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang*// sa phyogs 'di'i yul gzhi'i (423)gnas kyi bdag

/lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha// gser skyems= gzu dpang ni/ hūm̐/ phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba sras dang bcas// yi dam 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs rnams// brtse ba'i thugs rjes bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni rnal 'byor rig 'dzin sgrub pa po// sngags 'chang sgrub pa po la dgra byung na// bdag gi ma nyes ma g.yo srung mas mkhyen// gzu dang dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs// zhal lce snang srid lha 'dres mdzod// dam nyams dgra bo sdig can 'dis// dang po sangs rgyas bstan pa bshigs// bar du dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad// tha ma sngags 'chang gnyen po bral// da lta rnal 'byor bdag la bsdos// dge ba bcu ni khyad du bsad// mi dge bcu ni dang du blangs// mtshams med lnga ni 'bras bur smin// 'di ni bsgral ba'i zhing bcu yin// 'jam dpal zhi khro'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos (414)kyang*// rngam brjid tshul du khro bor skur bzhengs la// bsgral ba'i zhing bcu 'dul ba'i dus la babs// ma g.yel ma g.yel 'jam dpal gshin rje'i tshogs// dam nyams dgra bo sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ ces dang*/ skad cig gis e las gru gsum las kyi btson khang sogs brub bskyed/ 'gugs pa/ bla 'gugs/ lha dbye bcas kyi 'phros su/ rang nyid a tsa ra nag po 'jigs su rung ba gshin rje'i cha byad can zhal bsgrad mig gdangs mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas ral gri me 'bar ba 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdig pa mig dgu can bsnams pa/ thugs kar lcags kyi phag pa nag po zhig yod par sgoms/ nag po rakṣa hur hur/ shaṃ ra su ru dza rbad/ u pa laṃ mā ra ya sod/ tsi ti ka ru na rbad/ tri tri tsitta dkrugs/ ra tsa sha ma ra ya rbad/ nṛ dza/ dbugs la 'ub 'ub/ sdig pa nag po tsitta kā la mā ra ya hur thuṃ rbad dza nri dgra bo u tsa ta ya rbad/ a ka sa ma ya sha na mā ra dzaḥdzaḥrbad rbad shag shag trad trad/

zhes dang*/ gnod byed sarba sha ni mu long*/ kha shaṃ shaṃ/ brag tshal pa/ snying mgo chod/ mu lo chod/ rtsad nas chod/ drung nas phyungs/ ma ra ya dzaḥkarma (425) badzra a mu ka mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ badzra dril rbad/ badzra mug rbad/ kha rga myag rbad/ agne ye dzwa la raṃ raṃ/ a mu ka mā ra ya mā ra ya/ ghṛ na ghṛ na bhandha bhandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ a mu kā mā ra ya rbad rbad/ ces pa rnams dang*/ rang nyid tshe bdag nag po'i g.yon dang po'i lcags kyus byad ma'i snying ga'i nṛ la bzung nas phyag g.yas dang po'i 'khor los gtub par bsam/ oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakra sod/ he ka ya ma du ru tsakra sod/ ghṛ ma ya ma du ru tsakra sod/ sarba tsitta gzer thuṃ big nan rbad ya zlog ya/ dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa'i sha rgyus snying la mā ra ya/ dbugs rgyu srog la mā ra ya/ khrag rgyus rtsa la mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥzlog ya/ zhes pa rnams ci nus bzla/ hūm̐/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ sogs nas gzhung gi phur gdab yungs thun/ khrag thun/ mtshe thun/ thog thun rnams dang*/ gtso bo'i phyag mtshan drug dang*/ yum gshed bzhi/ las gshin bcas kyi phyag mtshan gyis bsgral ba dang*/ tho rdung bcas kyi las sngags mthar gong (416) gi bsad sngags gsum po sbrel/ zhal stob ni/ kiṃ ni ri ti la kha raṃ khā hi 'i rjes su bskang ba ni/ hūm̐/ drag po'i gdug pa tshar gcod phyir// gshin rje'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// gti mug rnam par dag pa'i phyir// bde gshegs sku yi rang bzhin te// gshin rje gshed po'i thugs dam bskang*// 'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i phyir// bdai gshegs gsung gi rang bzhin te// dug hrul ma yi= zhe sdang rnam par dag pa'i phyir// bde gshegs thugs kyi rang bzhin te/ phyag rgya zil gnon thugs= dam nyams mgo bo bskor ba'i phyir// gshin rje ya ma rā dza ni// bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang*// dam nyams yid ni dkrug pa'i phyir// gshed chen myos byed 'bar ba ni// bskang ngo=

dam nyams khrag tu skyug pa'i phyir// gshed chen arya me ru rtse// bskang ngo= dam nyams rdul du rlog pa'i phyir// gshed chen ral pa tshar dgu ni// bskang ngo= 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs ni// hūm̐/ bskang ba med de khams gsum yongs kyi bskang*// sgrol ba med de khams gsum (417)yongs kyi sgrol// sbyor ba med de khams gsum yongs kyi sbyor// ye sgrol ye sbyor chen pos thugs dam bskang*/ thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas ni// rgyu mchog chen po rnam lnga dang*/ mchog chen mchog phran mtshan ldan dang*// rang byung dam rdzas bdud rtsi dang*// rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang*// rakta dmar gyi dgyes mchod dang*// sha chen spos kyi dam rdzas dang*// rnal 'byor tshogs kyi longs spyod dang*// snang gsal zhun mar mdangs ldan ni// mkha' lding mdangs dang shel sgang dang*// tsa ra la sogs mdangs kyis bskang*// 'di ltar bskangs bskangs gsol gsol nas/ thugs rje gnyen po des bskangs la// cho ga lhag chad rdzogs gyur cig /bdag gi dbyar dam sor stsol cig /dbyar dam bskangs la rkyen dbang zlogs/ zhes rdzod do// dam can chen po rnams kyi skong ba ni/ badzra a mṛ ta= swa bhā ba= stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las gnas khang dur khrod drag po'i zhing khams bsam gyis mi khyab par phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa spyan gzigs (418)mthun rdzas rten rdzas skong rdzas la sogs pa thams cad srid zhi'i 'dod yon gyi rnam pa mkho dgu tshang ba/ bzang rgus 'byor pa/ mdzes dgus brgyan pa/ ngo bo ye shes sgyu ma'i rang bzhin bde ba'i rnam pa thams cad 'char bas nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo sogs lan gsum/ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ kye dgongs shig dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dgongs// sogs nas/ dam can 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ hūm̐/ bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po/

sogs nas/ sgrub phyir skul phyir gshegs su gsol// bar brjod do/ hūm̐/ ma hā ka la thugs rje can// sogs nas/ 'khor tshogs sprul pa'i thugs dam bskang*// bar dang*/ kyai/ dpal mgon ma ning 'khor bcas dang*/ /sogs nas/ bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs mdzod// bar brjod do/ phrin las gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i bstan srung rdo rje nag po che// lcam dral bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas rnams la// phrin las rab 'byams gsol dang skul ba'i phyir// mchod sprin rgya mtsho bstabs pas dgyes gyur te// kun bzang (419)he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag padma 'byung*// mchog gi sa brnyes rdo rje'i rig 'dzin tshogs// rim par byon pa'i rtsa brgyud bla ma yis// rgyud gsum dam can dregs pa'i dpung tshogs rnams// phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dod yon rgya mtshos mchod// bsten cing bsgrubs nas dbang bskur dam bzhag pa'i// zhal bzhes thugs dam g.yel bar ma mdzad par// srid zhi'i phun sum tshogs kun 'byung ba'i gzhi// rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// de tshul lung rtogs bshad sgrub kyis 'tsho ba'i// bstan 'dzin yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar mdzod// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing*// dge bcu'i 'byor pa rgya mtshos mtho ba dang*// 'jig rten khams kyi snod bcud legs tshogs kun// rab 'phel rdzogs ldan dpal gyis mtho bar mdzod// khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa sogs// phyi nang mi mthun rgud (420)pa kun zhi zhing*// bdud sde'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba mdzod// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod stobs// thos bsam sgom pa 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*// sa gsum 'gro ba kun dang de dag gi /phun tshogs dpal kun dbang du bsdu bar mdzod// mi srun log par sems pa'i dgra dang bgegs// nag phyogs bdud sde'i dpung dang bcas pa rnams// phrin las drag po shin tu mi bzad pas// ye shes dbyings su sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod// sems nyid gdod ma'i bstan srung re dgos dris// bslad min mtha' bral bde chen mngon gyur nas// phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba'i re skong ba'i// dngos grub rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis 'byor bar mdzod//

ces dang*/ rten rdzas sogs dmigs bsal dgos pa yod na/ dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas// mthun pa'i rdzas 'dir rten bcas dgyes bzhugs nas// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa yi// 'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun rkyen bsam don sgrubs// chos 'khor (421)'di yi bstan pa sde dang bcas/ khyod la gtad do rtag tu g.yel med skyongs// mthu rtsal nus skyed 'gal rkyen cham la phobs/ 'dod don stsolaba'i las kun sgrub par mdzod// ces brjod do/ tshogs la rol ba ni/ hoḥ zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di// 'dod yon ma spangs longs spyod brgyan// dngos grub sna tshogs 'di las 'byung*// rnal 'byor tshogs la dgyes par rol// zhes 'bul la/ a la la hoḥ sa blang ngo// de nas lhag ma'i gtor ma ni/ hūm̐/ dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyu// dpal chen khrag 'thung phud kyi bdag /bar du tshogs la mi rol rgyu// rnal 'byor longs spyod chen po'i bdag /tha ma kha phrus mi bran rgyu// ma srin mkha' 'gro lhag la rol// mnyam gsum gcig tu mi bsre rgyu/ chos nyid ye nas lhun grub gcig / zhes dang byin rlabs ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ pañdza a mri ta hūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lhag ma'i dam tshig 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes pa nam mkha' (422)gang bar gyur/ e ā ralli hrīng dzaḥ oṃ badzra puṣpe= shabta pra titstsha swa hā/ hūm̐/ ma dang mkha' 'gro dam can ma// bstan pa srung ba'i las mkhan ma// rdo rje'i rigs dang rin chen rigs// padma'i rigs dang las kyi rigs// ye shes mkha' 'gro thams cad kyang*// dam rdzas gnyen gyi gtor ma longs// rnal 'byor byin gyis rlob tu gsol// bstan srung bka' yi bya ra ba// lha mo mon mo bal mo dang*// dam tshig mkha' 'gro thams cad kyang*// dam rdzas gnyen gyi gtor ma longs// bstan pa gnyen po srung du gsol// dbang phyug mkha' 'gro 'bar ma dang*// ma sring ging dang laṅka dang*// las kyi mkha' 'gro thams cad kyang*// dam rdzas gnyen gyi gtor ma longs// rnal 'byor rkyen dbang zlog du gsol// utstshiṣṭa ba lingta khā hi/

zhes gtang ngo*// de nas zlog skul gyi phyir du/ hūm̐/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil sogs nas thugs dam rgyud skul bstod do phrin las mdzod// ces pa'i bar dang*/ zlog gzhung gi phyir du mdun skyed gzhung gi bstod pa/ hūm̐/ ma bcos rdzogs pa'i 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ /sogs nas tshig mtshams/ phyag 'tshal bstod/(423) zhes pa'i sham du/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus zhal du bstabs/ byad dang rbod gtong gnod pa zlog du gsol/ /zhes sbyar ba dang*/ bzlog pa dngos ni/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan khro rgyal gshin rje gshed// thams cad sgrol mdzad khro bo'i rje// srog la dbang mdzad bdud kyi gtso// dgra bgegs sha khrag srog la rol// las kyi gshin rje'i pho nya zlogs// yum chen gtum mo dug hrul ma// dam nyams dgra bgegs snying khrag rol// ma mo mkha' 'gro'i pho nya zlogs// gshin rje ya ma rā dza yis// dgra bgegs rnams kyi mgo bo bskor/ gshin rje pho nya'i dmag tshogs zlogs// gshed chen myos byed 'bar ba yis// dam nyams dgra bo'i yid dkrugs la// gshin rje srin po'i pho nya zlogs// gshed chen arya me ru yis// dgra bgegs khong khrag skyug du chugs// gshin rje bdud kyi pho nya zlogs// gshin rje ral pa tshar rgu yis/ dam nyams dgra bgegs srog rtsa chod// gshin rje gnod sbyin pho nya zlogs// 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje yis// rnal 'byor (424)bdag gi 'khor rnams la/ khrom dang shod la thebs pa zlogs// lus srog gnyis la gcod pa zlogs// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs rnams// sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la// dgra bgegs gnod pa'i sbyor ba zlogs// oṃ a kro te ka ya manta ka ha na ma tha bhandza hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ma hā maṃ sa la khā hiḥ ma hā rakta khā hiḥ ma hā tsitta kha hiḥ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hiḥ ma hā ba su ta khā hiḥ ma hā king ni ri ti khā hiḥ

zhes pa lan drug cu rtsa bzhi las mi nyung bar grangs gsag gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig go / mdun du zlog 'phyang ni/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe rgyal ba shāka thub la// sogs nas dam nyams byad ma'i steng du bhyo// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ a kro la ka ta nam yang sbyar ba nyer gcig tsam dang*/ rang nyid kyi phyag dang po sogs dang ban bon nyams pa= sogs brjod nas thal mo rdeb/ gong gsal yang zlog me yi spu gri'i zlog sngags/ e ka ya ma dang zlog pa spu gri'i 'khor lo e sa bhyo zlog rnams kyang ci nus dang*/ yang zlog rdo rje pha lam ni/ stong pa'i ngang las (425)bdud dang ru tra glang rgod chu glang zung bzhi bsnol ba'i steng du/ padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid tshe bdag nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba/ sku che la yan lag rags pa/ ri rab dang mnyam pa/ zhal gdangs la ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba gangs ri ltar gtsigs pa/ spyan mig phyogs bcur bsgrad pa/ ag tshom la me 'bar ba/ smin ma las glog 'khyug pa/ phyag g.yas pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa rno ba'i ngar dang ldan pa nam mkha' la phyar ba/ g.yon pas bsdigs mdzub kyi lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ gi sgra sgrog pa/ khams gsum g.yo ba/ ri rab 'gul zhing*/ rgya mtsho 'khyom 'khyom/ sde brgyad snang srid thams cad 'dar sngangs sngangs 'bog cing brgyal bar byed pa/ 'jigs su rung ba che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs (426)kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i 'od las 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs kyi 'og min nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang bdag nyid gzi brjid 'od dang ldan pa'i zhabs 'og tu dgra bo byad ma mkhan gan rkyal du mnan pa/ phyag g.yon pa'i lcags kyus dgra bo rnams kyi snying dkar nag mtshams nas bzung ba/

zhags pas mgul nas bcings/ bsdigs mdzub kyis bsdigs pas kha 'dar lus sbrid skyob pa'i lha dang phral nas 'dug par/ phyag g.yas pas 'khor lo bskor bas mgo lus thams cad dum bur gtub cing rdul phran bzhin du song bar gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ trig khroṃ bhyo/ ma ni mu ra ni bhyo/ ma ra du ni bhyo/ rakmo rakshan/ ting ya raksha bhyo/ mā ra ya/ ya ma ra dza/ kī la ya bhyo/

zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas mthar/ lag g.yas pa gnam/ g.yon pa sa/ gnam sa gnyis kyi bar du dgra bo rnams sgong lpags gtsir ba bzhin rdul phran du song bar bsam/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi (427)bka' bden pa dang sogs nas ma ra ya zlog bhyo/ bar gong bzhin la thal mo brdab/ de nas thun gtor la dmigs bya 'gugs pa ni/ na mo rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags dang rigs sngags dang gzungs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ chos nyid gdod nas stongs kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden= khyad par bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal bdud dgra'i dbang po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la snga dgra lag gis bsdar ba phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra thad du 'dzugs pa'i gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra dang*/ gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad srid pa gsum gyi khongs gar gnas gar bros kyang skad cig yud tsam dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig rtsa sngags mthar/ nṛ tri badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes bstim/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ gtor snod dmar (428)gyi dung chen yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor rdzas bsgral ba las byung ba'i sha yi ri bo khrag gi rgya mtsho rus pa'i phung po klad zhags gi lbu phreng 'khrigs pa/ dam tshig tu 'os pa'i 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med pas nam mkha' dang mnyam pas gang ba ngo bo zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa byin gyis brlab/ a kro te ka la gtor sngags btags pa gsum gyis 'bul la/ hūm̐/ drag po than gyi gtor ma 'di// sdang dgra gnod pa'i bgegs la btegs// lnga phung gzugs la gtor zor rgyobs// lus ngag yid gsum thal bar rlogs/

dgra bgegs las ngan rtsad nas chod// ces zor dgra phyogs su 'phang ngo*// gsol ka'i gtor 'bul la 'gugs pa thun gtor ltar la/ khyad par rdo rje'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya 'i sogs kha bsgyur la/ sngags sha sa na 'i mthar dgug bstim sngags dang oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa brlab/ pa sha na 'i sngags mthar gtor sngags btags pa lan gsum dang*/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ mchod sbyin (429)gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya che kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyi bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi sdang grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba// dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces gtor ma gtsang sar phul/ gtang rag ni/ oṃ shrī badzra dharma pā la sa pā ri ba ra arghaṃ nas shabta 'i bar dang*/ he ru ka dpal spyan snga ru// dam bcas ji bzhin da lta 'dir// bstan pa srung zhing skyong mdzad pa'i// dam can kun la bstod par bgyi// ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pa'i/(430)/'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs pa// de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad rigs// zhes dang yig brgya rjod/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// 'khor ba srid du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swa hā/ 'jig rten pa gatstsha gatstsha swa bhā bā nāṃ/ bsngo smon ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /he ru ka dpal 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/

de yi sa la 'god par shog / bkra shis ni/ rgyal ba'i bka' gsang bla med snying po'i don// sogs nas bkra shis bde legs yun du gnas par shog / zhes pa'i bar sde bdun bskang gso gzhung ltar btang rjes skul pa ni/ hūm̐/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /sogs nas thugs dam rgyud bskul bstod do phrin las mdzod// ces gong gsal dang*/ chad tho ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bka' yi bstan pa srung mdzad pa// gshin rje bdud dang ma mo dang*// gza' dang klu dang btsan dang lha// gnod sbyin srin po dgra lha rnams/ lha (431)srin sde brgyad thams cad kyang*// dam rdzas gnyen gyi gtor ma longs// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung du gsol// brtan ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bhyo/ slob dpon padma thod phreng gi /bka' nyan ma mo brtan ma'i tshogs// dam rdzas dpal gyi gtor ma longs// bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// bro mnan ni/ nṛ tri badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐/ gtor phyir 'brang ba'i dam sri rnams// rnal 'byor 'khor la bar gcod bgegs// gtor gzhong ri rab 'og tu mnan// bskal pa'i mthar yang mi gtong bar// lus ngag yid gsum nan gyis mnan// oṃ laṃ a laṃ hūm̐ laṃ sri nan/ rjes chog mchod bstod ni/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri bā ra ma hā shma sha na arghaṃ sogs dang*/ ma hā pañtsa a mrita khā hi/ ma hā ba lingta khā hi/ ma hā rakta kha hi/ mi gnas mi dmigs chos skur dag pa la// bdud 'dul khro bo mchog gi skur bzhengs pa// thugs rje gzi ldan gdug pa thabs (432)kyis 'dul// khro rgyal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su= sogs dang yig brgyas nongs pa bshags/ /'dir ni gzugs dang= sogs kyis brtan bzhugs lhar snang bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ gzhal yas gshed bzhi yum bcas gtso bo la// gtso bo nyid kyang mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings// a a a/

zhes pa cung zad mnyam par gzhag zung 'jug tu ldang ba/ phaṭaḥphaṭaḥphaṭaḥ slar yang rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i// gnas gsum 'bru gsum lus kun go chas gtams// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badzra kā bā tsi rakṣaṃ/ bsngo smon ni/ hūm̐/ sngon dus bskal pa dang po nas// tha ma da lta yan chad du// bsod nams dge ba'i las bgyis pas// 'gro rnams sdug bsngal grol gyur nas// sku gsum go 'phang thob par shog /bkra shis ni/ mchog gsum ngo bo rtsa rgyud bla ma dang*// 'jam dpal zhi khro yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// ma dang mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho yi// bkra shis phyogs dus kun tu khyab par shog / zhes shis pa brjod nas dge legs su bya'o/ sgrub zhag rdzogs nas (433) zor 'phang ba'i nyin zlog 'phyang yan grub nas gtor ma'i lha la mchod bstod nongs bshags sngar bzhin/ ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar btegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la thim par gyur/ slar yang gtor chen zor rdzas dang bcas pa skad cig gis 'jam dpal bdud dgra'i dbang po dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad kyis dmag tshogs khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs can srid gsum gang ba nad mtshon dug gi char 'bebs pas dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las la rngam par gyur/ gzhung gi zlog sngags nas yang zlog rdo rje pha lam zlog sngags thal rdeb bcas gong ltar gyis zor rdzas rnams la bsngags/ thun gtor la dgug gzhugs byin rlabs sngags 'bul bcas sngar ltar byas rjes/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas la// dgra bgegs sha khrag rus pa nang khrol tshogs// lhun por spungs pa'i 'dod dgu'i ba ling ta// phyi nang nyer spyod sman rag bdud rtsi'i tshogs// 'bul lo dgyes par rol la bdag cag gi /nad gdon kun zhi tshe dpal longs spyod spel// khams gsum dbang sdus dgra bgegs (434)bdud sde'i dpung*// thams cad ming gi lhag mar tshar chod cig /phas rgol bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byad stems rnams// thams cad rang gshed phob la mthu nus shigs// mdor na bdag gi re 'bras gang yin pa// 'bad med lhun gyis 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod//

ces thun gtor gtor chen du 'bul/ de nas sgo dbye ba ni/ gtor ma'i lam bstan gang du bstan// gtor ma'i lam bstan phyogs bzhir bstan// phyogs bzhi'i rgyal chen sde bzhi po// rang rang 'khor tshogs mang pos bskor// sku zur de ni spyan byol cig /gtor zor dmar po sha ra ra// khrag zor dmar po kyi li li// thun zor ser phran nyi li li// mda' zor skar ltar brengs se breng*// thod zor rbab ltar 'dril li li// phur zor sha la thems se them// rdo zor thog ltar rbad de rbad// steng gi lha la zor mi 'phen// lha chen brgyad po zhabs sdus shig /'og gi klu la zor mi 'phen// klu chen brgyad po dbu 'phang smod// bar gyi (435)gnyen la zor mi 'phen// gnyen chen sde bzhi sku zur cig /zor 'di dgra bgegs steng du 'phen// rnal 'byor bdag gi sdong grogs mdzod// ces zor lam bsal/ hūm̐/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil sogs kyis skul ba dang*/ hūm̐/ bka' yi bstan pa srung mdzad sogs kyis chad tho gtong*/ gza'i rgyu phyogs dang bstun nas lam du gtor tshugs sting skul/ gser skyems dang*/ 'phang sar sleb nas bskul/ gser skyems 'phros srid zhu'i rgyab yig bklag dmigs bya dgug gzhug dang*/ zor skul ni/ hūm̐/ drag po gshin rje'i gtor zor 'di// sdang ba'i dgra la gtor zor yang*// dgra bo'i bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod// gnod byed bgegs la khrag zor ya// mo rgyud khrag gis mngal nas skoms// thun zor bu rgyud tsha la ya// bu tsha bdun brgyud rtsad nas chod// mda' zor sgo yi nar la rgyobs// sgo nor god 'dre phyag mas thobs// thod zor nang khang sris la ya// phyag mas thal ba rlung la skur/ phur zor dgra bo'i snying la ya/(436)/drag po'i gri thab nad kyis sod// rdo zor dgra bo'i mkhar la ya// skye bo 'khor ba'i rgyun lam chod// byad kha zlog la phur kha sgyur// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod//

ces dang*/ zor g.yang ba ni/ hūm̐/ khrag 'thung 'jam dpal gshin rje yi/ pho nya mngags pa zor gyi bdag /dgra bgegs sgrol phyir las la ya/ ༈ gnam lcags shugs ldan gtor ma'i zor/ ༈ glog ltar 'khyug cing thog ltar 'bebs// dgra bgegs lus sems 'ben la ya/ e ka ya ma sogs kyis zlog sngags bzlas la 'phang tshig gzhan 'dra ba la/ gtor zor gyi mtshams su/ rba klong 'khrugs pa khrag gi zor/ ༈ sna tshogs 'dus pa thun gyi zor/ ༈ rno myur shugs drag mda' yi zor/ ༈ shugs drag stobs ldan thod pa'i zor/ ༈ gsod byed drag shul phur pa'i zor/ ༈ ri bo nyil ba rdo yi zor/ zhes rim bzhin bcug la zor rdzas rnams 'phang*/ de nas zlog 'phyang ni/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe rgyal ba shaka thub la sogs brjod/ de nas 'gugs gzhug dang bcas gtor chen 'phen ba ni/ hūm̐/ dmar chen gtor zor gshin rje'i (437) tshogs// sde brgyad dregs pa'i dpung dang bcas// dgra dang bgegs kyi steng du rbad// srid pa 'pho zhing 'khrug byed pa'i// dmag dpung der spyod g.yul ngo sprod// dgra dpung choms la bgegs dpung thul// rjes shul lhag ma med par mdzod// dus la babs so mthu rtsal skyed/ /ces brjod pas gnod byed kho rang gi lha srung rnams bdud du bab stai khyi rub pa bzhin du kho rang hab sha hab sha ling ling za bar bsam la/ hūm̐/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams me yi rba klong 'khrugs// sogs kyis srung 'khor gyis mtshams bcad/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis rting mnan te yar ldog sgrub khang sgo drung gtor gzhong bshal ba'i phud kyis brtan ma'i gtor mar bran te/ bhyo/ slob dpon padma thod phreng gi sogs kyis brtan ma bskyang*/ rang nyid skad cig gis sdig pa nag po yan lag drug pa/ kha dang rwa rtse las dug gi me 'bar ba/ kha nas ngar skad drag po sgrog par gyur pa'i mdun du klu bdud nag po sbrul mgo stong yod pa/ lus sbrul gyis gang ba/

kha nas yams nad dang dug mtshon sna tshogs 'tshub (438)pa/ nad kyi rlangs pa'i nang na bzhugs pa/ sbrul nag gi zhags pa'i zhal nang du dgra bgegs gang yin pa de tshud par gyur/ dgug gzhug nan tan dang*/ dmar gtor dang ling ga dngos su bsgyur la/ oṃ nag po ti pa tsa ya/ na ga rakṣa tsakra phe laṃ hūm̐/ nag po baṃ/ tsitta la rgyobs/ trag thur/ snying thur/ 'gul 'gul/ myag myag rtsa bzhi skums/ shan shan/ a mu ka'i srog la shan/ thur thur/ dgra bo'i snying la thur/ dza nan/ rbad nan sod/ nā ga ha la zo/ ma rig dgra bo'i snying la thum/ bhyo rbad/ nā ga ru tra ka la sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakra a mu ka st+waṃ bha ya nan/ he ka ya ma du ru tsakra a mu ka st+waṃ bha ya nan/ gṝ ma ya ma du ru tsakra a mu ka st+waṃ bha ya nan/ sarba tsitta a mu ka lha srung dang bcas pa gzer thum/ big nan trig nan rbad ya zlog ya/ byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa'i mthu stobs dang lus ngag yid gsum st+waṃ (439)bha ya nan/ srog la mā ra ya rbad hūm̐ phaṭaḥzlog ya/ zhes bzla la mnan no kha bcad steng gtor gzhong kha sbubs pa ri rab tu gyur bas mnan par bsam la/ hūm̐/ gtor phyir 'brang ba'i dam sri rnams/ sogs kyis bro brdung*/ gtor gzhong kha gyen du bstan la/ mchog gsum ngo bo rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*/ sogs kyis shis pa rjod/ nang du log la/ gong gsal tshe snyen cung zad dang bcas/ hūm̐/ tshe la dbang mdzad gshin rje'i gshed/ sogs rjod/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ gzhung gi mdun bskyed kyi lha ye shes par gsal ba'i sogs nas yā ma ra dza hūm̐ phaṭaḥbhyoḥ zhes pa'i bar gyis dngos grub rdzas la rol/ chos skyong gi gtor 'bul rjes chog rnams sngar bzhin dang*/ gtang rag mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ brtan bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bkra shis rnams gong du bshad par ltar bya'o// padma'i zab chos kun gyi ngo mtshar phul// lho gter smin pa 'bras bu lta bu yi// mkha' 'gro'i gsang gter nyer lnga'i mchog gyur pa// chos rgyal ratna gling pa'i khyad nor yin// rten 'brel gnad rnams sne gcig ma log pas// sku tshe gcig la gling pa gsum gyi

(440) don// mthar phyin rjes 'jug rnams kyang dge mtshan gyi// nyin mo byed 'di chos 'di'i khyad chos lags// 'di ni drag sngags mthar thug gshin rje'i gshed// 'jigs byed me yi spu gri'i man ngag gnad// gab sbas spangs nas brjen gcer phyungs ba la// nongs mchis chos bdag srung mas bzod par bzhes// 'on kyang skye 'dir rgyal dbang dpal yul ba'i// gral du skyes pas zab gter 'di nyid la// mang nyung rgyas bsdus rigs pas gang 'phrul yang*/ bka' babs yin phyir som nyi'i skabs dang bral// dge tshogs bdud rtsi'i zegs ma ni// kun mkhyen rgya mtshor 'bab pa las// mtha' yas ma gyur yid can kun// 'jam dpal dpa' bo nyid gyur cig /ces pa'ang o rgyan bsam gtan gling pa'i lo mjug gi dus gtor chen mor nye bar mkho bas mtshams sbyar te rig 'dzin pa dpal chen 'dus pas bka' brgyad rdzong 'phrang gshin rje'i sgos sgrub gzhir bzung*/ rang gter 'di'i man ngag rnams kyis kha brgyan te gter chen brgya rtsa'i bka'i sdud po 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyis phyag bzhes kyi rjes su 'brangs nas bris pa dge legs 'phel/ 'di dang gter gzhung ma bu'i lag len sbrel na srid gsum brlag pa'i mtshon char 'gyur bas rang

(441) 'dod can gyi spyod du med par las gshin 'chi bdag nag po la gnyer du gtad do// badzra sa ma ya rakṣantu 'o// zab gnad de tsam mi dgos na ser ma rnams skyur/ shin tu 'jam po dgos na chags med rin po che'i gzhung rkyang dngos bstan rnams las 'di'i rno so yang zlog dmigs bzlas rnams skyur/ 'don cha kha bsabs pas mthus pa yod do// sngar gyi phyag rgyun ratna'i lugs yin na// 'di yang ratna gling pa'i zhal rgyun yin// sngar gyi zhal gzigs nye rgyud lugs yin na// ngas kyang rmi lam tsam du zhal mthong myong*// byin rlabs yod na gnyis char 'dra 'dra yin// rtsed mo kha mtshar ha cang spobs pa mtho// ha ha// dge'o//
